title: RDFR-CI: Reference Implementation, Scenario Library and Evaluation Harness
description: Supplementary and reproducibility package for the RDFR-CI paper. It includes the core governance equations, a 30-scenario illustrative library spanning 18 critical-infrastructure sectors, uncertainty and sensitivity analyses, multi-agent authority demonstrations, publication figures and tables, a pre-specified SWaT A1/A2 validation pipeline, and an executed SWaT A11 normal-operation threshold-transfer experiment. A separate controlled perturbation challenge exercises event-level D(phi), RDFR-CI authority mapping, and 10,000-resample authority bootstrap logic. SWaT raw data are not redistributed, and synthetic perturbations are not represented as empirical attack-detection performance.
notes: ARTICLE DOI: pending; SOFTWARE DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22662284. The final manuscript is submitted separately. This archive contains supplementary/reproducibility materials and excludes restricted SWaT raw data.
